title: Decision brief: stop / continue / accelerate framework for mid-quarter roadmap readout
creator: Ava Patel
description: Produce an evidence pack and a concise decision brief using a stop / continue / accelerate lens for the mid-quarter roadmap readout. The goal is to give execs and cross-functional partners a fact-backed set of asks (resource shifts, canaries, or paused work) and the metric thresholds that justify each recommendation.
background: We have 12 active initiatives across product, infra, and platform with mixed velocity and SLO regressions on two runtime features. Leadership asked for a lightweight, repeatable decision framework for mid-quarter adjustments so we avoid ad-hoc changes during QBR prep. This ticket standardizes the format and compiles the supporting evidence (performance telemetry, cost delta, customer signal, and required engineering effort).
objectives: Deliver a 1-page decision brief that lists recommended stop / continue / accelerate actions for each high-risk initiative
Attach a 6-slide evidence pack with charts and links to dashboards that substantiate recommendations
Provide clear success/failure thresholds and resourcing delta (FTE-weeks) per recommendation so Finance and EngOps can approve quickly
data_needed: Per-initiative velocity trend (sprint throughput, open PR age) - from Jira/GitHub
Runtime SLOs: Token P50/P95 latency and error rate trends - from observability dashboard
Cost signal: $/1k tokens and infra run-rate delta per model variant - from billing dashboard
Customer signal: Support tickets, NPS comments tagged to feature, pilot feedback summaries
decision_criteria: Stop: initiative has negative customer signal, >=2 sprints of declining throughput, and >15% projected cost increase unless paused
Continue: initiative meets baseline customer acceptance, stable or improving SLOs, and <10% incremental cost
Accelerate: initiative shows strong customer traction, SLOs within target and positive efficiency (cost or latency) improvements; requires clear runway and +1 or +2 FTE-weeks commitment

post_readout_followups: If a stop decision is approved: open formal pause ticket in ENG backlog and notify customers in pilot list
If an accelerate decision is approved: create scoped spike tickets for the first two sprints and update Dedicated capacity forecast
If any decision triggers >$50k expense: route to Finance approval flow and log in the release notes
